cases.prompt: Critique these interface screenshots and distinguish tested, untested, and inferred states.
cases.note: Screenshot and untested-state discipline from references/review.md. A screenshot alone must not be reported as certifying more than it shows.

cases.prompt: Review this app against WCAG 2.2 and separate automated evidence from untested conformance claims.
cases.note: Original frontend-review boundary case (WCAG-companion). The companion places the recorded findings; this skill still owns the review workflow and the finding contract, per references/review.md.

cases.prompt: Capture Lighthouse accessibility and performance scores for this page and flag any claim in the report that the scan alone cannot support.
cases.note: Lighthouse-evidence companion to r002: a Lighthouse run is one evidence lane, not a substitute for manual inspection or a standards certification; see the claim-boundary section in references/review.md.

cases.prompt: Review this interface and then fix what you find.
cases.note: A clear review-and-fix request contains change intent. Implement owns the approved change lifecycle and UI/UX supplies design judgement plus the fresh read-only review after the repair.

cases.prompt: Audit this product's design system for token and component drift; report only and make no edits.
cases.note: Design-system audit remains a read-only focus inside UI/UX design rather than becoming a competing top-level skill.

cases.prompt: Consolidate the approved design-system tokens and migrate the existing UI consumers.
cases.note: A design-system change stays a UI/UX focus, while implementation owns source mutation, migration, verification and handoff.

cases.prompt: Review this app-owned preview with the Playwright skill, but keep the entire attempt read-only and do not edit source.
cases.note: Check browser availability/version without downloading it implicitly. Keep navigation, snapshots and screenshots read-only, with output outside the reviewed tree; mark unavailable browser evidence not tested.

cases.prompt: Capture light and dark desktop screenshots of the two screens this branch changed and review them for visual regressions without editing anything.
cases.note: Changed surfaces only, both themes, and the reviewer looks at every capture before judging.

cases.prompt: Build an interactive prototype of two competing dashboard layouts for the owner to choose between, then implement the chosen one.
cases.note: A prototype awaiting the owner parks that item; other work continues.
